tasks.label: Read election records
args: require('dotenv').config({ path: '.env' }); const url = process.env.DATABASE_URL; if (!url || decodeURIComponent(new URL(url).pathname).replace(/^\/+/, '') !== 'eops_local') { console.error('DATABASE_URL não aponta para o banco local esperado.'); process.exit(2); } const { PrismaClient } = require('@prisma/client'); const prisma = new PrismaClient(); prisma.election.findMany({ select: { id: true, name: true }, orderBy: { name: 'asc' } }).then(rows => { for (const row of rows) console.log(JSON.stringify(row)); }).catch(() => { console.error('Falha na consulta Prisma.'); process.exitCode = 1; }).finally(() => prisma.$disconnect());
